extracted.intended_audience: patent applicants, patent attorneys, national IP offices, policymakers and stakeholders interested in Eurasian patent statistics and EAPO performance
extracted.subtask_description: An official annual-report-style compilation of metrics and statistics about Eurasian patent applications, grants, maintenance, and related procedural outcomes for 2020. Used to summarise EAPO activity and portfolio characteristics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total number of Eurasian applications filed
rubrics_metrics.description: The Eurasian Patent Office received 3,377 applications for Eurasian patent protection in 2020. Overall, the Eurasian Patent Office had 60,731 Eurasian application filings since establishment (1996–2020).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used as a headline activity metric and yearly comparator (year-on-year decline of about 3% in 2020). See Diagram 1 for multi-year progress.

rubrics_metrics.name: Breakdown by filing procedure (international/direct/national-channel)
rubrics_metrics.description: International applications, direct filings with EAPO, and applications channeled via national IP offices of EAPC Contracting States are reported separately. In 2020: international applications = 2,486 (73.6%), direct = 511 (15.1%), national-office-channeled = 380 (11.3%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Diagram 2 distributes the Eurasian applications subject to the specificities of the filing procedure; useful for assessing sources of filings and procedural mix.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographical origin of applications (country-of-origin distribution)
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications are cascaded by country of origin showing counts and percentages (e.g., USA 991 applications or 29.3% in 2020; applicants from EAPC Contracting States filed 679 applications).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Diagram 3 provides a visual cascade; used to identify major filing countries and geographic trends.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribution by technical field / IPC classification
rubrics_metrics.description: Breakdown of Eurasian applications filed in 2020 by subject matter / IPC classes (Table 1). Example shares: Organic chemistry (C07, A01N) 24.65%; Medications and pharmaceuticals (A61K) 22.63%; Biochemistry (C12-C14) 5.13%; Total = 100%.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to assess technology-area concentration of filings and monitor sectoral trends (the report notes bulk of applications in organic chemistry, pharmaceuticals and medicines).

rubrics_metrics.name: Electronic filing share
rubrics_metrics.description: Number and percent of applications filed electronically. In 2020, 2,996 applications were filed electronically, representing 89% of all Eurasian applications filed that year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicator of digitisation/adoption of e‑filing by applicants; useful for operational planning and service delivery.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of Eurasian patent grants (annual and cumulative)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Eurasian Patent Register saw 2,735 new entries in the reporting year. For period 1996–2020 there were 36,888 Eurasian patents (reports also give a 2020 grants figure of 2,754 and cumulative totals).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Primary output metric for patent grant activity and year-on-year comparison (2020 grants exceeded 2019 by 2.11%).

rubrics_metrics.name: Grants by owners' country of residence
rubrics_metrics.description: Breakdown of Eurasian patents granted in 2020 by patent owners' country of residence with counts and percentage shares (Table 2). Example: US 550 (19.97%), RU 334 (12.13%), DE 216 (7.84%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to identify which countries' applicants obtain grants and their relative shares; separates EAPC Contracting States vs states not party to EAPC.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grants based on PCT regional-phase entries
rubrics_metrics.description: Number and share of Eurasian patents granted that originated from PCT applications entering the EAPO regional phase. In 2020, 2,107 such patents (79.80% of grants) and 76.51% of total grants were PCT-based.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reports also provide country distribution for PCT-based grants (Table 3); useful to measure the PCT pipeline contribution to EAPO grants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent term expirations (termination due to 20-year term under Article 11)
rubrics_metrics.description: Count of Eurasian patents terminated due to expiry of the twenty‑year term under Article 11 of the Eurasian Patent Convention. As of 31 December 2020, 653 Eurasian patents had been terminated for this reason.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tracks lifecycle completions of patents in the register.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patents in force
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of Eurasian patents in force on the territory of the EAPC Contracting States and the Republic of Moldova. As of the same date, patents in force reached 17,410.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates the active portfolio size and national coverage of enforceable rights.

rubrics_metrics.name: First annual fees paid (counts, country origin, designations, average designations)
rubrics_metrics.description: Details of first annual maintenance fee payments in 2020: number of patents for which the first fee was paid by country of first patent owner's origin, number/percentage of designations of EAPC Contracting States and Moldova, and average number of designations per patent. Table 4 shows totals and country breakdowns; overall average number of designations at first payment = 3.72.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to assess patentees' interest in maintaining designations and geographic validation choices at first renewal stage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subsequent annual fees paid (counts, country origin, designations, average designations)
rubrics_metrics.description: Details of subsequent annual maintenance fee payments in 2020: number of patents for which subsequent fees were paid by country of first patent owner's origin, number/percentage of designations, and average number of designations per patent. Table 5 gives totals and country breakdowns; overall average number of designations for subsequent payments = 3.37.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicator of long‑term maintenance behaviour and regional validation patterns across patent lifetimes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Average number of EAPC designations per patent (first and subsequent payments)
rubrics_metrics.description: Reported average number of designations of the EAPC Contracting States and the Republic of Moldova at the stage of first payment = 3.72; for subsequent payments = 3.37.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarises extent of geographic validation chosen by patent owners and changes over patent lifecycle.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recurrence of designations by Contracting State
rubrics_metrics.description: Percent recurrence of designation of individual EAPC Contracting States and Moldova relative to patents for which the annual fee was paid. Examples for first payments: Russian Federation – 96.43%, Kazakhstan – 57.66%, Belarus – 49.84% etc.; for subsequent payments: Russian Federation – 97.33%, Belarus – 43.93%, Kazakhstan – 50.37%, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shows which Contracting States are most frequently chosen/maintained by patent owners; useful for policy and market focus.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patents restored after lapse for non-payment
rubrics_metrics.description: Count of Eurasian patents restored after lapse due to non‑payment of annual maintenance fees. In 2020, 111 Eurasian patents were restored.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates use of restoration procedures and the scale of temporary lapses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent term extension under Rule 16(5) of EAPC Patent Regulations
rubrics_metrics.description: In conformity with Rule 16(5), which provides for additional legal protection for products requiring special permission for application, the validity of 29 Eurasian patents was extended on request by relevant patent holders (distributed across Armenia, Belarus, Kazakhstan, Russian Federation).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identifies grounds and use of term-extension mechanism for products needing special permission (e.g., regulatory delays) and records number of extensions granted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registered license agreements information disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: National IP offices contributed information on registered license agreements based on Eurasian patents; information about 45 registered license agreements based on 63 Eurasian patents was published in the EAPO Gazette in 2020.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tracks licensing activity tied to Eurasian patents and public disclosure of such agreements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Designation counts and distribution per patent (detailed per-country designation counts)
rubrics_metrics.description: Tables provide numbers of designations of each EAPC Contracting State and Moldova per group of patents (first and subsequent fee payments), enabling calculation of average designations per patent and per-country designation totals (Tables 4 & 5 contain extensive per-country counts).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enables analyses of how many states patentees designate on average and the distribution of those choices across countries; used for strategic decisions and fee-income analysis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Categorisation of applications by 'subject to specificities of the filing procedure'
rubrics_metrics.description: The report notes that Diagram 2 distributes the Eurasian applications subject to the specificities of the filing procedure, implying categories of application types based on procedural specifics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful for operational understanding of different procedural streams (e.g., direct, PCT regional phase, national-channelled) and their proportions.
